advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Ensure the real-jira max_retries=0 test actually executes in CI: add a lane (or extend an existing one) that installs the [jira-datacenter] extra AND collects tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dc_summary_executor.py, otherwise the skipif makes it a permanent no-op that gates nothing.
evidence: Test gate: `_JIRA_SPEC = importlib.util.find_spec("jira")` / `_NEEDS_JIRA = pytest.mark.skipif(_JIRA_SPEC is None, reason="the `jira-datacenter` extra is not installed")` (test lines 391-394)
pyproject.toml:201-203 — `jira` is supplied ONLY by the `jira-datacenter` extra: `jira-datacenter = [ "jira>=3.8,<4", ]`; the `dev` extra does not pull it

.github/workflows/_build-and-test.yml:349 — primary unit lane installs `uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra reviewbot --extra ui` (no `jira-datacenter`), so find_spec('jira') is None and the test SKIPS

.github/workflows/external-integration.yml:555 installs `--extra jira-datacenter` but line 624 runs only `pytest -m external tests/external/live_jira_dc` — the new test lives at tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/mutate/test_dc_summary_executor.py and has no `external` marker, so it is never collected there
.github/workflows/jira-dc-capability-map.yml:52-63 explicitly does NOT install `[jira-datacenter]` and runs no pytest
Docstring claim at test lines 389-390: 'it runs for real only where jira-datacenter is installed (the DC integration environment)' — contradicted by the CI wiring above
advisory.finding: The new real-library test test_real_jira_library_disables_sdk_retries_when_constructed_offline never executes in any CI lane, so it gates nothing. Its skipif condition (find_spec('jira') is None) is only false when the [jira-datacenter] extra is installed, and no lane that installs that extra collects this unit-test path. The primary unit lanes install only dev/reviewbot/ui extras (so the test skips), while the sole jira-datacenter-installing lane runs `pytest -m external tests/external/live_jira_dc` — a different path with an `external` marker this test does not carry. The docstring's claim 'the extras lanes run it for real' is not supported by the CI configuration.
